title: Unsoundness in `Arc::make_mut` if `handle_alloc_error` unwinds
author: maxdexh
body_preview: Same code path as in https://github.com/rust-lang/rust/issues/155746  When there are only weak pointers left, `Arc::make_mut` creates a new allocation and moves the data inside it. It does so after `compare_exchange(1, 0)`-ing the strong count.
